entries.source: Ranged fighters coming to the arena looking for wealth and glory, just like you.
entries.target: 前来竞技场寻求财富和荣誉的远程斗士，就像你一样。

entries.source: A menacing man in heavy armor, wielding a mace. He looks battle-hardened.
entries.target: 一个身着重甲、手持钉头锤的凶悍男人。他看上去久经沙场。

entries.source: A Halfling slinger. He seems adept at combat.
entries.target: 一位半身人投石者，他似乎很擅长角斗。

entries.source: A Human Arcane Blade. His body shows multiple scars from battle.
entries.target: 一位人类奥术之刃。他身上伤痕累累，都是战斗留下的。

entries.source: A Human dressed in black robes. He mumbles in a harsh tongue. He seems to think you are his slave.
entries.target: 一位穿着黑色长袍的人类。他用刺耳的语言喃喃自语。他似乎认为你是他的奴隶。

entries.source:
A towering creature, made from the bones of hundreds of dead bodies. It is covered by an unholy aura.
This specimen looks like it was hastily assembled and is not really complete yet.
entries.target:
一座铁塔一样的怪物，由数百具尸体的骨头组成。它周身环绕着不洁的光环。
这个标本看起来像是仓促拼凑而成，尚未真正完成。

entries.source: This pile of rotting flesh twitches and makes horrid noises.
entries.target: 这团腐肉抽动着，发出可怕的噪音。

entries.source: This pile of bones appears to move on its own, but it can't seem to organise itself into something dangerous.
entries.target: 这团骨头看起来在自行移动，但似乎无法将自己组织成危险的形态。

entries.source: It looks like a giant blood clot. Is that what its creator intended?
entries.target: 它看起来就像一个巨大的血块。这是它的创造者的本意吗？

entries.source: A black cloak, with subtle illusion enchantments woven into its very fabric.
entries.target: 一件黑色斗篷，布料中织入了细微的幻术魔法。

entries.source: A paper scrap, left by the Necromancer.
entries.target: 一张死灵法师留下的纸片。

entries.source: A towering sand drake stands before you. This wingless worm is mighty and could easily crush you.
entries.target: 一只铁塔般的沙龙站在你面前。这只无翼巨虫非常强大，可以轻易碾碎你。
远行传送门：至远东大陆

entries.source: A farportal is a way to travel incredible distances in the blink of an eye. They usually require an external item to use.
entries.target: 远行传送门能让人眨眼间跨越难以想象的距离。它们通常需要借助外部物品才能使用。

entries.source: #VIOLET#You enter the swirling portal and in the blink of an eye you are back to the far east.
entries.target: #VIOLET#你进入了传送漩涡，一眨眼功夫你发现你回到了远东大陆。

entries.source: A Human in shiny plate armour.
entries.target: 一位穿着闪耀板甲的人类。

entries.source: Go %s! We will hold the line!
Renegade mages from Angolwen, the Sorcerers have set up in the Far East, slowly growing corrupt. Now they must be stopped.
entries.target: 来自安格利文的叛逃法师——巫师们已在远东立足，并逐渐腐化堕落。现在必须阻止他们。

entries.source: Damn you, you only postpone your death! Fyrk!
entries.target: 该死，你只是在拖延你的死亡而已！弗莱克！

entries.source:
Faeros are highly intelligent fire elementals, rarely seen outside volcanoes. They are probably not native to this world.
This one looks even nastier and looks toward you with what seems to be disdain. Flames swirl all around him.
entries.target:
炎魔是高智慧的火焰元素，在火山以外的其他地方很少看到。它们很可能不属于这个世界。
这只看起来更加凶残，它用蔑视的眼神看着你。火焰在它的身上流转。

entries.source: and a sole piece of char was sent to his masters as a totem
entries.target: 并只把一块焦炭作为信物送到了他的主人那里

entries.source: Hurry down south while the sun-paladins are holding off the orcs. Make their sacrifice worth it!
entries.target: 太阳骑士在这里挡住了兽人，请快向南方过去，不要让他们的牺牲白费！
